QUOTE: `skipSync` (in `handleReactions`) ... `skipSync: true` ... "Returns `deleteReactions: []`. Stale reactions on the post are not pruned. This is the 'incremental add' mode; a full post sync would pass `false`."
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer says `skipSync` stops pruning of stale reactions, but never says the incoming single reaction would otherwise be treated as the post's complete set, so every other reaction would be deleted.
